title: "Main effects models"
format: html
execute: 
  eval: false
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(BGLR)

Y <- readxl::read_excel("Y_CV.xlsx")

nIter <- 20000
burnIn <- 5000
```

# GBLUP

```{r}
load("EZ.rda")
load("GDec.rda")
```

## CV1

```{r}
folds  <- 1:5
```

### Yield

```{r}
yield <- Y$yield
env <- Y$environ
uenv <- unique(env)

set.seed(1)

ETA <- list(
  list(X = EZ, model = "FIXED"),
  list(V = GDec$vectors, d = GDec$values, model = "RKHS")
)

list_metrics <- list()

for (fold in folds) {
  
  cat("  Processing Fold", fold, "\n")
  
  testing <- which(Y$CV1 == fold)

  yNA <- yield
  yNA[testing] <- NA
  
  fm <- BGLR(
    y = yNA,
    ETA = ETA,
    nIter = nIter,
    burnIn = burnIn,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  yHat <- fm$yHat
  
  for (a in uenv) {
    
    idx_env  <- which(env == a)
    join <- intersect(idx_env, testing)
    
    if (length(join) > 1) {
      
      cor_val <- cor(yHat[join], yield[join])
      
      list_metrics[[length(list_metrics) + 1]] <-
        data.frame(
          Fold = fold,
          Environment = a,
          Predictive_Capacity = cor_val
        )
    }
  }
}

df_metricas <- do.call(rbind, list_metrics)

df_metrics <- bind_rows(list_metrics) %>% 
  group_by(Environment) %>% 
  summarise(pred = mean(Predictive_Capacity), sd = sd(Predictive_Capacity), .groups = "drop")

writexl::write_xlsx(df_metrics, "GBLUP_CV1_Yield.xlsx")
```

```{r}
  yNA[testing] <- NA
  
  fm <- BGLR(
    y = yNA,
    ETA = ETA,
    nIter = nIter,
    burnIn = burnIn,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  yHat <- fm$yHat
  
  for (a in uenv) {
    
    idx_env  <- which(env == a)
    join <- intersect(idx_env, testing)
    
    if (length(join) > 1) {
      
      cor_val <- cor(yHat[join], protein[join])
      
      list_metrics[[length(list_metrics) + 1]] <-
        data.frame(
          Fold = fold,

          Predictive_Capacity = cor_val
        )
    }
  }
}
```

## CV0

```{r}
folds  <- 1:6
```

### Yield

```{r}
yield <- Y$yield
env <- Y$environ
uenv <- unique(env)

set.seed(1)

ETA <- list(
  list(X = EZ, model = "FIXED"),
  list(V = GDec$vectors, d = GDec$values, model = "RKHS")
)

list_metrics <- list()

for (fold in folds) {
  
  cat("  Processing Fold", fold, "\n")
  
  testing <- which(Y$CV0 == fold)

  yNA <- yield
  yNA[testing] <- NA
  
  fm <- BGLR(
    y = yNA,
    ETA = ETA,
    nIter = nIter,
    burnIn = burnIn,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  yHat <- fm$yHat
  
  for (a in uenv) {
    
    idx_env  <- which(env == a)
    join <- intersect(idx_env, testing)
    
    if (length(join) > 1) {
      
      cor_val <- cor(yHat[join], yield[join])
      
      list_metrics[[length(list_metrics) + 1]] <-
        data.frame(
          Fold = fold,
          Environment = a,
          Predictive_Capacity = cor_val
        )
    }
  }
}

df_metricas <- do.call(rbind, list_metrics)

df_metrics <- bind_rows(list_metrics) %>% 
  group_by(Environment) %>% 
  summarise(pred = mean(Predictive_Capacity), sd = sd(Predictive_Capacity), .groups = "drop")

writexl::write_xlsx(df_metrics, "BSL_CV0_Yield.xlsx")
```
